goal: Create a comprehensive network scanner that can scan ports, resolve hosts, and output results in JSON format
acceptance_criteria: All network scanning functionality (scan_port, resolve_host, scan_network) is properly implemented and tested
Input validation for ports and hosts works correctly
Support for CIDR notation in host specification is implemented
JSON output format is produced correctly
Comprehensive error handling for socket operations is in place
Detailed logging for debugging and progress tracking is included
